split.policy: multiplicative price normalization from structured face-value factor
split.identity: resolve action ISIN through point-in-time symbol_history to the symbol active on ex-date
split.volume: normalize pre-event share volume by inverse price factor
split.blocking: only if a large residual discontinuity remains after normalization

bonus.policy: multiplicative price normalization from structured bonus ratio
bonus.identity: same point-in-time symbol-history resolution as split
bonus.volume: normalize pre-event share volume by inverse price factor

name_or_symbol_change.policy: same-ISIN symbol history is stitched into one continuous security history
name_or_symbol_change.fallback: if identity continuity cannot be established, do not synthetically stitch across different ISINs

demerger.policy: structural reset; never infer a synthetic multiplicative factor
demerger.feature_gate: exclude snapshots whose -252..0 trading-session feature window crosses the event
demerger.label_gate: censor y6/DD30/+25/+50 labels crossing 1..126 sessions; y12/y24 censored at their own horizons

merger.policy: same structural reset/censor logic as demerger
merger.disappearing_security: map event to first session on/after ex-date, or last session within 30 calendar days when the target ceases trading

note: These are data-integrity rules, not performance tuning. They were defined before reviewing v2 corrected validation results.
